t: A free beginner Python editor with a step-by-step debugger built in.
steps: Download Thonny from the official site for Windows or macOS.
Linux users can install it through a package manager.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Avoid Flatpak or Snap builds. The shell may not work in them.
Open Thonny and run a one-line print program.
Use the debugger to step through a short loop.
Try the Raspberry Pi Pico learning path if you have boards.
